notes.title: Sex Universe [18+] is coming out soon! 🌌
notes.content:
A spiritual successor to Universe in Cum, which rethinks it and does it in new, better ways, is nearing its release. The story will revolve around a girl named Alice who is participating in a live sex game hosted interplanetary. Things unfold in the future, so humanity is in contact with a whole lot of other species and civilizations, making the show even more fascinating. The show is streamed online, and the best participant is chosen by the audience - whoever they like better is the winner. No rules, no boundaries, no dullness - only the hottest and most ardent players get to participate and show off intergalactically. 
The game is coming this Saturday, so don't miss the release - we've got something special prepared! 😉
